description: The dependency manifest of an owner record: the generator contracts are no file, so what the inference of one owner READ of them travels in its record as one `global` row (`path` = JSON [name, workspaceRoot], `fact` = a ReadsTree). Every other global fact (registry rows, command inputs, module sources) is already a row or part of the key. The key of an owner record holds the owner's own inputs only: [registryDigest, commandRevision (native owners), assemblyAuthority (native or pipeline owners), 'closure-references/4', root, json, selectedTargets, selectedInputs].

ReadsTree.description: A node is a map from a property name to a primitive (the value that was read), to a child node, to {absentMarker: true} (the property was read and absent), and holds optionally keysMarker (the own keys that were listed) and hasPrefix+name (an `in` probe and its answer).
